target.statement: S&S-RB method achieves F1-score of 93.25 on the australian dataset (vs 91.81 CV(F1) and 92.74 CV(Hinge)), with run time 0.71 s

compute.basis: No code released; the S&S pipeline (kernel approximation via RKS/Tensor Sketch, S&S computation, lookup-table C selection, single SVM fit) plus the 5-fold CV grid-search baseline must be reimplemented from the paper text, then run on a small 690-sample dataset — CPU-only, minutes of actual compute but substantial reimplementation risk.

blockers: No code or configs released; S&S computation and kernel-approximation details (RKS/Tensor Sketch settings, kernel grid, C grid) must be reverse-engineered from text
Exact F1 depends on unspecified train/test split and kernel-parameter grid, so matching 93.25 exactly is unlikely
Table 1 S&S values appear internally inconsistent (e.g., balance/banana rows), complicating validation of the S&S computation
title: Separability and Scatteredness (S&S) Ratio-Based Efficient SVM Regularization Parameter, Kernel, and Kernel Parameter Selection
